reviews.title: Met expectations. Buy with confidence.
reviews.comment: Purchased to upgrade an older (5 years) Laptop that has an upper RAM limit of 16gb, came with 8. Recognized immediately. Ran a few memtest's including Memtest86+, everything was good, no errors. Matched expected capacity, speed etc. Well oackaged, standard plastic holders. No problems, buy with confidence.
reviews.author: Soldat_1958

reviews.title: Installed in a Dell XPS 7590
reviews.comment:
I didn’t want to pay for the inflated RAM prices directly from Dell when I first ordered my XPS.  I waited about a year and almost always use a crucial for RAM when it comes to regular use laptops.
Other than Dell being dumb and using Torx screws, the RAM itself worked great.  Not taking stars off for Dell’s PITA design.  Computer booted,  pricier me of a RAM change and then loaded into Linux Kubuntu.  Everything read correctly and tests show it works as advertised in the specs.
reviews.author: Brandon Pierce

reviews.title: If your computer sess has one ram slot but to modify it actually has two. Totally worth it!
reviews.comment: They work exactly what I want them to do. Make my slow pc faster! Totally worth it!

reviews.title: Good value RAM
reviews.comment:
I had to return the 1st set that I was sent. The PC would boot with 1 stick but would give me beep codes when the second stick was added. The replacement set worked fine. These are sent in a clamshell packaging that didn’t have any seal to indicate that it had been used/returned before it was sent to me.
Wonder if the 1st bad set will eventually be sent to another customer?
reviews.author: J. Nicolls
